_comment: 规格 352 G4 批第 1/4 部分（20 条）。
★ 事实来源：output/_briefs/G4.json 的 evidence / current_doc，以及 impl 函数的 docstring。
★ 首句 = <动词> <对象> <关键限定>，≤120 字符；整段 ≤600 字符；参数说明英文句号收尾。

solidworks_feature_readback.doc: Read one feature back from the tree to check that it really exists. It rebuilds the model unless do_rebuild is false, then reports presence, rebuild success, the What's Wrong count and the last few feature names; ok is true only when the feature is present, the rebuild worked and the What's Wrong count is 0.

params.feature_name: Feature name expected in the tree, spelled as this SolidWorks interface shows it.
params.do_rebuild: Whether to rebuild the model before reading it back. Defaults to true.

solidworks_render_material_list.doc: List the render material objects applied in the active document. Read-only; an empty document returns an empty list, and nothing is converted or applied.

solidworks_sketch_dimension_horizontal.doc: Add a horizontal dimension whose text is placed at the given pick point. Requires a sketch to be open, it writes a display dimension into that sketch, and it does not save the document.

params.x_mm: Pick point X in millimetres, where the dimension text is placed.
params.y_mm: Pick point Y in millimetres, where the dimension text is placed.

solidworks_sketch_dimension_vertical.doc: Add a vertical dimension whose text is placed at the given pick point. Requires a sketch to be open, it writes a display dimension into that sketch, and it does not save the document.

params.x_mm: Pick point X in millimetres, where the dimension text is placed.
params.y_mm: Pick point Y in millimetres, where the dimension text is placed.

solidworks_feature_revolve_cut.doc: Revolve a sketch profile as a cut and remove material around an axis. It selects the axis sketch before the profile because that order matters, writes a cut feature into the active part and does not save the document.

params.sketch_name: Name of the sketch that defines the profile, selected with mark 0.
params.angle_deg: Revolve angle in degrees; it is converted to radians once at this boundary.
params.axis_sketch_name: Name of the sketch holding the revolve axis, selected with mark 4 or 16 before the profile. Defaults to unset, so no separate axis is selected.

solidworks_sketch_rotate.doc: Rotate the selected sketch entities about a centre point. It writes the rotated geometry into the open sketch and does not save the document; the returned report compares the sketch bounding box and the sketch transform before and after.

params.center_x_mm: Rotation centre X in millimetres, converted to metres once at this boundary.
params.center_y_mm: Rotation centre Y in millimetres, converted to metres once at this boundary.
params.angle_deg: Rotation angle in degrees, converted to radians once at this boundary.

solidworks_surface_offset.doc: Insert an offset surface at a given distance from a face that this tool selects itself. It writes a surface feature into the active part and does not save the document, and the insert call returns nothing, so success shows only as a new feature in the tree.

params.thickness_mm: Offset distance in millimetres, converted to metres once at this boundary.
params.reverse: Whether to offset to the other side. Defaults to false.

solidworks_surface_planar.doc: Insert a planar surface from the closed boundary that is currently selected, such as a sketch or a loop of edges. It writes a surface feature and does not save the document; select the closed boundary first, and success needs both a non-false return and a new feature in the tree.

solidworks_surface_replace_face.doc: Replace a solid face with a surface face. It writes a replace-face feature and does not save the document; select the face to replace with mark 1 and the replacement face with mark 2 first, and use solid faces rather than surface bodies.

solidworks_surface_untrim.doc: Untrim a surface so the trimmed-away part of the face grows back. It writes an untrim feature and does not save the document; it is valid only on surface parts and requires the face or edges to be preselected, and success shows as a new feature in the tree.

solidworks_surface_flatten.doc: Flatten a surface body into a flat surface feature. It writes a flatten feature and does not save the document; the tool selects the surface face with mark 1 and a vertex with mark 16 by itself, and it reports preconditions_held false when there is no surface body to flatten.

params.accuracy_factor: Flatten accuracy factor from 1 (highest accuracy) to 10; the real-machine run used 4. Defaults to 4.
params.should_use_tears: Whether to allow tears in the flattened result. Defaults to false.

solidworks_surface_sweep.doc: Skip this tool, NOT USABLE on this machine: every entry point returns nothing and the tree stays unchanged. It is meant to sweep a surface from a selected profile and path, but it writes no geometry into the part, so do not use it and do not read a returned report as a built feature.

solidworks_surface_revolved_ref.doc: Revolve a profile into a reference surface about a centreline. It writes a surface feature and does not save the document; select the profile before calling, and 3D sketches are not supported.

params.angle_deg: Revolve angle in degrees, converted to radians once here; with rev_type 1 it is the total angle.
params.rev_type: Revolve type: 0=one direction, 1=mid-plane, 2=two directions. Defaults to 0.
params.reverse_dir: Whether to revolve the other way. Defaults to false.

solidworks_curve_through_points.doc: Insert a curve through a list of XYZ points. It writes a curve feature into the active part and does not save the document; success is judged by the three call returns together with a new feature in the tree.

params.points_mm: Points as a list of [x, y, z] triples in millimetres; the API coordinate unit is assumed to be metres, converted once here and echoed back in the report.

solidworks_feature_loft_cut.doc: Loft a cut through the selected sketch profiles. It writes a cut feature and does not save the document; profiles must be selected first and in the order you want them used, and success needs a new feature whose type name is Blend.

params.closed: Whether to close the loft. Defaults to false.
params.use_selected_profiles: Whether to use the profiles that are already selected. Defaults to true.

solidworks_weld_symbol.doc: Insert a weld symbol on a face of the active part. It selects the face at face_index first, writes an annotation and does not save the document, and success is judged by reading the symbol back rather than by the returned flag.

params.face_index: Index of the face to select before inserting the symbol. Defaults to 0.
params.top: Whether to draw the symbol above the horizontal line instead of below it. Defaults to false.
params.left: Text for the left side of the symbol. Defaults to empty.

solidworks_assembly_explode_line_sketch.doc: Insert or close an explode line sketch in the active assembly. It writes a sketch into the assembly and does not save it; the assembly needs an exploded view first, and success is judged by the feature tree and the active sketch rather than by the returned flag.

solidworks_drawing_create_projected_view.doc: Insert a projected or model view of a saved part into the active drawing. It writes a view and does not save the document; the model must already be saved with a path ending in .sldprt or .sldasm, and English view names such as *Front are resolved to this machine's localized name.

params.part_path: Full path of an already saved model file ending in .sldprt or .sldasm.
params.view_name: View orientation such as *Front, *Top or *Isometric; English names are resolved to the local names. Defaults to *Front.
params.x_mm: X of the view centre in millimetres. Defaults to 140.
params.y_mm: Y of the view centre in millimetres. Defaults to 120.
params.scale: View scale written as 1/scale, where 0 leaves the sheet default. Defaults to 0.

solidworks_drawing_create_section_view.doc: Insert a section view at the given position on the active drawing. It writes a view and does not save the document; a section line must already be selected because this tool selects nothing, and it reports preconditions_held so an empty selection is not read as a failure of the call.

params.x_mm: X where the section view is placed, in millimetres.
params.y_mm: Y where the section view is placed, in millimetres.

solidworks_drawing_create_detail_view.doc: Insert a detail view at the given position on the active drawing. It writes a view and does not save the document; the drawing needs a detail circle, a sketch circle, in the source view first, and scale is the numerator with the denominator fixed at 1.

params.x_mm: X where the detail view is placed, in millimetres.
params.y_mm: Y where the detail view is placed, in millimetres.
params.scale: Numerator of the detail view scale with the denominator fixed at 1, so 2.0 means 2:1.
params.label: Label text for the detail view; empty uses the SolidWorks default.

solidworks_drawing_set_sheet_format.doc: Set the sheet format, that is the drawing frame, of the active drawing from a format file. It writes the new format and does not save the document; it rebuilds afterwards so the first-angle or third-angle projection refreshes, and success is the read-back path matching the requested one.

params.format_path: Path of the sheet format file ending in .slddrt.
